- Base colors: only the four regulars, S #9d4355 (--shani), G #c4921c (--mark-gold), B #34649a (--tekhelet), U #772ba3 (--argaman).
- Each thread gradient adds two derived shades, which are not tokens:
  - S: edge #74323f, highlight #ab5f6b
  - G: edge #9d7516, highlight #d3b05c (edge .80, highlight .34)
  - B: edge #264a72, highlight #547ba5
  - U: edge #582079, highlight #8c4bac
  - Others use edge .74 and highlight .17. Highlights are tinted toward LINEN #f1e9d8, which is not a site token (--bg is #ebdec3).
- The hailstone glint is #c6d4e3. The .com dot is a B to U gradient.
- No site bold or dim token appears in the logo: not shani-dim, tekhelet-bold, tekhelet-dim, gold, gold-dim, line, mark-ink, ink-strong, sel, ink, muted, faint or argaman-dim.
- Closest accidental matches: the U edge #582079 is about --ink #561f86, and the B edge #264a72 sits near --tekhelet-bold #22508a. The G edge #9d7516 sits between --gold #a06c10 and --gold-dim #a3762a.
- Red has no site bold for the logo to borrow.

LUMINANCE ORDER, with contrast on --bg:
- Red: shani #9d4355 4.68, then shani-dim 3.06.
- Blue: tekhelet-bold 6.11, then tekhelet 4.59, then tekhelet-dim 2.56.
- Gold, darkest to lightest: hover-ink #704c0f 5.78, line 3.79, gold 3.39, gold-dim 3.04, mark-ink #bd890f 2.34, mark-gold #c4921c 2.11, hover-line 1.87. The retired deep mark gold #76500c is about 5.6.

'That dark gold' is most likely #76500c, the deep mark gold the owner said "just barely looks gold to my eye". The bright choices already ruled are #bd890f (marks, D) and #c4921c (the name). Avoid anything near --hover-ink #704c0f or #76500c for the name.

HELPERS (lines 59-63). hx and toh parse and format hex, rounding and clamping to 0-255. mix(a,b,t) is a + (b - a) * t per sRGB channel, with no linearization. shade(c,f) multiplies each sRGB channel by f, which moves toward black. tint(c,t) is mix(c, LINEN, t).

EDGE AND HIGHLIGHT. thread(id, c, angle, edge, hi, P) at lines 102-108 sets e = shade(c, edge) and h = tint(c, hi). It builds a vertical objectBoundingBox linearGradient with stops 0 e, .22 c, .46 h, .78 c, 1 e: a round thread with a dark rim, the base color, and an off-center sheen. That gradient fills a userSpaceOnUse pattern 400 x P (P=42 font units, about 2.5px at the door's 416px), rotated by the given angle. The factors are set at line 150 with `(.80, .34) if c == G else (.74, .17)`: the gold's rim is 80% of the base and its sheen is 34% toward LINEN; every other color's rim is 74% and its sheen is 17%. The letters, the flame, the hailstone, the color change at the "a" and "d" of "and" (still no green), and the blue-into-purple dot of ".com" are all where they were, but the stripes show more than on the live logo, "fire" and "hail" come out a little lighter, and "and" is a little deeper, the gold of the site's borders.
draft.mapping:
The threads repeat in groups of three, darkest to lightest. Thread j of the whole mark wears tier (j mod 3) of its own color, so the light thread is the same thread in every word and runs straight on through the hand-offs.
- RED, "fire" and the flame: --shani #9d4355, --shani #9d4355, --shani-dim #b76670. The site has no bold red, so the regular takes the bold's place and red uses two tiers (one regular-wide band, then one dim thread).
- GOLD, "n", the gold halves of "a" and "d", and the flame's heart: --gold #a06c10 (the borders' gold), --gold-dim #a3762a (the borders' dim gold), --mark-gold #c4921c (the name's own gold, the logo's old gold). These are ordered by lightness, because the site's "dim" gold is not lighter than --gold. --mark-gold is kept as the light thread: the site uses it (.wm-and, and .wjoin.lic.active .wj-ink at zone.html line ~837), and the owner asked for "the same gold as the borders and logo was".
- BLUE, "hail", the hailstone, and the blue half of "d": --tekhelet-bold #22508a, --tekhelet #34649a, --tekhelet-dim #7f8ba8. All three tiers.
- PURPLE, "c", "o", "m": --sel #4f1789 (the site's "bold purple", worn by pressed controls; argaman has no bold of its own), --argaman #772ba3, --argaman-dim #9c69b9.
- THE DOT OF .COM: woven the same way. Each thread runs from its blue to the purple of the same tier: #22508a to #4f1789, #34649a to #772ba3, #7f8ba8 to #9c69b9.
- THE HAILSTONE'S GLINT: --held-tekhelet #b9c6e6.
- THE DOOR HAIRLINE: still --gold-dim #a3762a (not part of the SVG).
- UNCHANGED: the letter shapes, the 42-unit thread spacing, the 60-degree angle, the hand-offs with their one crossover thread, the viewBox (-14 -845 7102 879), and img width=710 height=88.
- MEASURED: zero green pixels in the "d" at door, 28px and pill sizes. Mean ink at the door compared with live: fire #a95662 vs #9d505b, and #96744d vs #9b8053, hail #4e6f9b vs #436b97, .com #7b40a3 vs #7c3a9e. Fire and hail are a little lighter, "and" a little deeper, .com about the same.
- RETIRED: #bd890f appears nowhere. All derived shades, LINEN #f1e9d8, the old glint #c6d4e3 and the black and white overlays are gone. The SVG holds exactly 12 hex values, each the exact hex of a zone.html :root token.

verdict.tiers_present:

It has exactly 12 hex values, all flat fills or gradient stops. There are no opacity attributes, no #000 or #fff overlays, no LINEN, no #c6d4e3 and no #bd890f. Each value is the exact hex of a zone.html :root token.

RED ("fire" and the flame): --shani #9d4355 is regular and fills 2 of every 3 threads. --shani-dim #b76670 is dim.

GOLD ("n", the gold halves of "a" and "d", and the flame's heart): --gold #a06c10 is the regular gold of hover, focus and pressed borders. --gold-dim #a3762a is dim. --mark-gold #c4921c is the name's own gold.

BLUE ("hail", the hailstone and the blue half of "d"): --tekhelet-bold #22508a is bold, --tekhelet #34649a is regular and --tekhelet-dim #7f8ba8 is dim. The hailstone's glint is --held-tekhelet #b9c6e6, which is a blue ground token, not an ink tier.

PURPLE (".com"): --sel #4f1789 is the bold, borrowed from the ink ladder. --argaman #772ba3 is regular and --argaman-dim #9c69b9 is dim.

THE DOT OF .COM: three gradients, one per tier: #22508a to #4f1789, #34649a to #772ba3, and #7f8ba8 to #9c69b9. The ends are tokens. The pixels between are blends, which the 2026-10-03 transition ruling allows.

TIER SURVIVAL: in renders, each tier is a distinct color. At door size at DPR 2, roughly 27-30% of ink pixels sit within RGB distance 14 of each blue and each purple tier, and the same of each gold tier in "n". At 28px at DPR 2 the shares are 22-26%.
verdict.tiers_missing:
RED: there is no bold. No such token exists, so the regular fills the bold's slot and red shows 2 tiers. This is honest, and the draft says so.

GOLD: there is no named bold gold token. --line #93661a, the gold of every structural 1px border (header rules, pills, panels), is not used, even though the owner said "the same gold as the borders". The draft reads "borders" as --gold #a06c10, which is the hover, focus and pressed border gold, as the computed task directed. Also unused: --hover-ink #704c0f and --hover-line #c19f66. --mark-ink is now var(--gold), so it is covered.

In practice gold reads as 2 tones, not 3. --gold and --gold-dim are only dE 8 apart (L* 49.8 vs 52.9), and the site's "dim" gold is not lighter than its regular.

PURPLE: argaman has no bold token, so --sel from the ink ladder stands in. Also unused: --ink #561f86, --ink-strong #44166c, --muted #6c359e and --faint #845ba7.

BLUE: nothing is missing.
issues: The texture of the weave the owner likes has changed in character. The live mark has fine round threads, each 42 units wide with its own rim and sheen, a period of about 2.5px at the door. The draft has flat bands. Because neighboring tiers merge (red: regular, regular, dim; blue: bold and regular only dE 9 apart; gold: --gold and --gold-dim only dE 8 apart), the eye sees a light stripe every 3 threads, a period of about 7.4px at the door. At door size it reads as bold diagonal candy stripes, not fine cloth. It is still recognizably the same logo, but it does not look 'like itself' in texture. The owner said "thats why i like the logo weave design" and "dont change everything by my eye".

'and' is visibly deeper and browner, not 'a little'. The mean ink of the 'n' at door size goes from #c49934 to #b08125: dE 9.6, L* 65.6 to 57.1. The draft's summary understates this. It follows from the owner's 'same gold as the borders', but it is the largest single shift in the mark. Fire changes by dE 3.3, hail by 2.7 and .com by 2.8.

At small sizes the mark is busier than live. At 28px, 24px and the 15.6px home pill, live blurs to near-flat color. The draft's dim threads stay visible as hatching across the strokes, most of all in 'hail', where --tekhelet-dim #7f8ba8 is a grayish blue at 2.56:1 on linen and cuts the thin i and l into segments. Every word still reads at 28px, but legibility at pill size is a step below live.

The hailstone's glint is --held-tekhelet #b9c6e6. That is a ground token which zone.html defines but never reads. It is not an ink tier. If the pending palette fold (task #64, 'Fold the palette to 2/2/2/2 and 3 linen') removes unused tokens, the glint becomes a stray with nothing tracking it. Dropping the glint, or using --tekhelet-dim, would be safer.

The bold purple is --sel #4f1789 from the ink ladder, not from argaman. The owner ruled '.com in argaman'. This is defensible as the site's 'bold purple' (2026-10-03: "maybe bold purple would be better?"), but it mixes the two purple ladders inside one word, and the owner should be told.

The draft reads 'the borders' gold' as --gold #a06c10. The site's structural borders, though, are --line #93661a, and the masthead hairline directly under the logo is --gold-dim #a3762a. The draft follows the computed task's reading. The term is ambiguous for an owner who is not a color person.

The builder still hand-types every tier hex in TIERS. Nothing reads zone.html, and no check compares the SVG to the :root tokens, so the 'uniform coloring' goal is unguarded: the next token change, for example the pending palette fold, silently desynchronizes the logo. This gap predates the draft, but the draft depends on it more than live did, since 12 values are copied by hand instead of 4.

A minor doc nit in the builder header: the new 'THE SITE'S OWN TIERS' block was inserted above the existing '- mark(uid, False) draws the same mark without threads...' bullet, so that bullet now sits under the new header. The bullet's 'every other page prints the name as text' was already stale before this draft (the home pill carries the mark since 2026-10-08).

The checks found nothing wrong in these: zero green pixels in the 'd' or any part at door, door@2, 28px, 28px@2, 24px@2, pill and pill@2, by the inventory's green metric (hue 65-170, sat > 0.12). A 50/50 blend of any blue tier with any gold tier lands at hue 34-67 with saturation 0.05-0.26, olive-gray rather than green, the same family as live. The thread phase is continuous across the a and d hand-offs, each with its one crossover thread. The flame's heart reads gold. The .com dot reads blue into purple. The viewBox -14 -845 7102 879 and width 710.2 and height 87.9 are unchanged.
